correctness.rationale: On the repaired RESULT.md, the key diagonal-census lemma has a uniform proof. The frozen proof asserted a distance-doubling induction without showing how the refinement counts intermediates across components; its displayed first-round formula was correct but the sentence identifying it as the last surviving round was off by one. The repair gives an inductive pair descriptor consisting of clipped endpoint data and a short oriented distance or far flag. Witnesses close to one or both anchors can be counted in their interval charts, and distant witnesses are counted from a common type histogram minus the near occurrences. The cycle length hypothesis excludes a second short arc, including at the last diagonal step. Conversely the colors reveal distance clipped at the dyadic scale and nearest-endpoint distance clipped at 2^s−1; comparing exposed endpoint counts detects m<2^(s+1)−2, and a short-cycle ball without endpoints is too small to be any path ball of the same radius without endpoints. Thus equality is exactly the pair of thresholds. Degree census forces any same-order round-one survivor to be one path plus cycles. Optimizing the exact thresholds gives a minimum order 3·2^s−1 for survival to diagonal round s≥1, attained by a single cycle; round zero, orders 2–4, and P_1 are handled separately. The checked game bridge adds one to first distinguishing round, and fixing the order allows a finite conjunction. Independent replay `python3 /tmp/opencode/frozen-independent-checks.py paths` used within-graph witness domains and joint color names on 390 exhaustively partitioned rivals of orders 5–18 and 20 test cases around both dyadic cutoffs through scale 6. All agreed. Finite evidence is corroboration of the repaired uniform proof only.

value.rationale: Exact depth, as opposed to a logarithmic bound or full-pair stabilization on one graph, is a natural benchmark for logical definability of paths. The uniform mixed census explains the extremal rival and its two independent obstructions, and supplies the exact order at each depth transition. This is additional information beyond the known bridge or either isolated threshold index.
